query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twin_growth_status (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  twinId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  level INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  experience INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  evolutionType VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'basic' NOT NULL,
  energy INT DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  fullness INT DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  mood INT DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  bond INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalConversations INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalImageGenerations INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalFriendPredictions INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalScenarioAnswers INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalDiagnosticsCompleted INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalKnowledgeEntries INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  lastInteractionAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  consecutiveLoginDays INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  lastLoginDate VARCHAR(10),
  evolutionHistory JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twin_skills (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  twinId INT NOT NULL,
  skillType VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  level INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  experience INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  unlockedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  maxedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS twin_milestones (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  twinId INT NOT NULL,
  milestoneType VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  icon VARCHAR(10),
  achievedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  metadata JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS experience_history (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  twinId INT NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  experienceGained INT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  metadata JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
